From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@acmeretail.com>, J. Morales <jmorales@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Short-notice patch deployment & request for customer validation

Sofia / J,

Quick note to let you know we just deployed an unscheduled hotfix to the inference runtime that addressed an edge-case where long-context requests could intermittently return truncated responses. The fix went live at 08:05 PDT and affected the us-west serving pool only.

What we did (high level):
- Deployed a micro-patch to the tokenization and KV-cache reconciliation path.
- Enabled a safety timeout guard to prevent early termination for sequences >8k tokens.
- Applied a rolling restart to 30% of instances followed by a progressive rollout across the cluster.

Impact to Acme Retail:
- Most requests unaffected; about ~0.3% of your historical 8k+ token calls may have seen truncation prior to this fix (we flagged and reprocessed known in-flight requests).
- No data loss; requests were either retried or returned an error which we caught and logged.

Customer action requested:
1) Please validate any active batch jobs or long-form generation workflows you have running today.
2) If you see any truncation or altered outputs, reply with the sample request id(s) and timestamp.

Attachments: hotfix_readme_v1.0.pdf (contains rollout notes), rollback_instructions.txt

I know this was short notice — apologies for that. We pushed this hotfix because the window of impact was growing and we wanted to avoid a broader regression during today’s peak.

I'll follow up in ~2 hours with an internal timeline and the ask for a short postmortem with your team to capture any residual issues.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Sofia — answers inline and a quick next steps list.

Endpoints / scope:
- Traversal/generation endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream — these are the ones that touched long-context logic.
- We tagged and reprocessed known in-flight requests with IDs that matched the truncation pattern; sample request ids included in the Drive doc.

Response shape / tokenization change:
- No schema changes. We did not change JSON response fields. Tokenization tweaks were internal fixes to boundary handling only — they should be backward compatible with your parsers.

Immediate next steps for Acme:
1) Run validation on any workflows that rely on >8k token sequences (priority).
2) If you find altered outputs, paste the request id + timestamp and we’ll do a side-by-side re-run and provide diff.
3) If anything is blocking, reply with URGENT in the subject and we’ll mobilize ops/engineering.

We will also: share a short postmortem draft by end of day and ask for a 30-minute sync tomorrow to capture customer impact and remediation items.

Attachments: postmortem-feedback-form.md (please add any notes you want us to include)

Thanks again for the quick turn — appreciate your help validating.

Vanessa
